اخرنطمت (form IIIq)
# اِخْرَنْطَمْتُ (iḵranṭamtu) /ix.ran.tˤam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# اِخْرَنْطَمْتَ (iḵranṭamta) /ix.ran.tˤam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# اِخْرَنْطَمْتِ (iḵranṭamti) /ix.ran.tˤam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِخْرَنْطَمَ (iḵranṭama)
# اِخْرَنْطَمَتْ (iḵranṭamat)
